value.text: I confirm there's no external broker involved, just an in-process queue — asyncPostQueue defined in webhook.go with workers spawned at init, a buffer of 128 slots, and 4 goroutines processing it, dropping messages if the buffer fills. I also check webhook_test.go and the docs for any queue references, and note there's no persistence or retry mechanism in place.
